common.secureDocuments: Legal documents are never exposed through public URLs.
common.signInRequired: Please sign in to use this section.

overview.title: A calm command center for legal work.
overview.description: The platform foundation is ready for secure, observable legal operations across teams and organizations.
overview.nextStepBody: Identity and multi-tenancy will establish secure membership boundaries before business workflows are introduced.

operations.title: An operational foundation you can trust.
operations.description: Every core capability has an explicit contract, a checkable state, and a safe path to scale.

health.title: Health and observability
health.description: Clear readiness checks for every required service.

async.title: Asynchronous processing
async.description: A queue foundation with bounded retries and durable handoff.

events.title: Event safety
events.description: Outbox and idempotency foundations to prevent duplication and loss.

integrations.title: Services with clear boundaries.
integrations.description: Integrations pass through independent layers, keeping secrets and private links outside the client.

login.title: Sign in to Mohamy Pro
login.description: Use your workspace identity to access legal operations securely.

settings.title: Language belongs in the foundation.
settings.description: Language and direction can change from day one without changing navigation or accessibility behavior.
settings.accessibilityTitle: Accessibility is part of the default
settings.accessibilityBody: Keyboard navigation, semantic labels, and contrast-aware colors are supported by this shell.

identity.title: Memberships and tenants.
identity.description: Bootstrap the first tenant, invite and manage memberships, and switch the active workspace.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap the first tenant
bootstrap.description: Authorized operators can create the platform's first tenant with a server-issued secret.

tenantSwitch.title: Switch active workspace
tenantSwitch.description: Move the current session to another tenant you are a member of.

invitation.createDescription: Invite a person by provider subject (recommended) or email, and grant one or more roles.
invitation.acceptDescription: Paste the shareable token to join a tenant.
invitation.createSuccessBody: Share the token privately with the invitee. It expires automatically.
invitation.acceptSuccessBody: The invitee is now an active member.
invitation.bindingHint: Provide a provider subject or an email to bind the invitation.

membershipAdmin.title: Manage tenant memberships
membershipAdmin.description: Suspend, expire, remove, or reinstate a membership in the active tenant.

roles.title: Roles and assignments
roles.description: Create tenant roles, grant permissions, and assign roles to members. Built-in roles are immutable.

orgConfig.title: Shape the operating hierarchy.
orgConfig.description: Create the organization, branches, departments, teams, and tenant settings that define how work is structured.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: A location or unit under the organization.

team.title: Team
team.description: A flat assignment construct scoped to the tenant.

clients.title: Manage the people and organizations you work with.
clients.description: Create and manage individual clients and organizations, track their contact channels and addresses, and archive them when no longer needed.

list.title: Client list
list.description: Search and filter the clients in the active workspace.

contact.title: Contacts
contact.description: Contact channels (phone, email, fax, website, mobile) for a client.

conflictChecks.title: Screen prospective parties for conflicts of interest.
conflictChecks.description: Request a conflict check before accepting a matter, review prospective parties against existing clients, and record an allow or block decision with a reason.

check.title: Conflict check
check.description: Request a check and manage its review decision.

list.title: Conflict check list
list.description: Search and filter the conflict checks in the active workspace.

parties.title: Manage the legal counterparts you work with.
parties.description: Create and manage parties — people or organizations — that may be linked to a client, assign configurable roles, and record party-to-party relationships.

party.title: Party
party.description: A person or organization legal counterparty.

list.title: Party list
list.description: Search and filter the parties in the active workspace.

relationship.title: Relationships
relationship.description: Party-to-party links (spouse, subsidiary, related entity, etc.).

cases.title: Manage the legal matters you work on.
cases.description: Create and manage cases (matters), track their status and priority, and link the parties and roles involved.

case.title: Case
case.description: A matter record with number, client, status, and priority.

list.title: Case list
list.description: Search and filter the cases in the active workspace.

party.title: Case parties
party.description: Link parties and their roles to a case.

assignments.title: Case assignments
assignments.description: Assign members to a case; assigned-scope holders see only their cases.

breakglass.title: Break-glass access
breakglass.description: Emergency case access with mandatory reason, expiry, and audit.

casesTimeline.title: Case timeline
casesTimeline.description: An append-only, chronological history of everything relevant to a case.

timeline.heading: Case timeline
timeline.description: View the immutable timeline and append explicit events for a case.

legalConfig.title: Configure the courts and legal jurisdictions your firm operates in.
legalConfig.description: Build the legal dictionary for your workspace — countries, jurisdictions, courts, and court locations. Countries are a shared global dictionary; jurisdictions, courts, and court locations can be tenant-specific or global.

country.heading: Countries
country.description: Create managed countries that populate the global dictionary.

jurisdiction.heading: Jurisdictions
jurisdiction.description: Attach tenant or global jurisdictions to a country.

courtLocation.heading: Court locations
courtLocation.description: Add branches and physical locations to a court.

workflows.title: Define standard operating procedures.
workflows.description: Configure state machines, transitions, and automated workflows.

hearings.title: Manage upcoming and past court hearings.
hearings.description: Schedule hearings, record outcomes, and manage court appearances.

deadlines.title: Legal Deadlines
deadlines.description: Manage case deadlines, create calculation rules, and track upcoming deadlines.

tasks.title: Task Management
tasks.description: Manage operations, delegate responsibilities, and track task statuses.

documents.title: Document Management
documents.description: Upload, manage, and share legal documents securely.

secureLinks.title: Secure Access Links
secureLinks.description: Generate time-bound secure URLs for external sharing.

billing.title: Bill matters with an immutable ledger.
billing.description: Create fees and expenses, build draft invoices from approved time, issue and collect payments, and read the append-only ledger.

fee.heading: Fees
fee.description: Create fixed, hourly, retainer, or milestone fees.

expense.heading: Expenses
expense.description: Record case expenses flowing into invoices.

invoice.heading: Invoices
invoice.description: Build drafts from approved time, fees, and expenses.

lifecycle.heading: Invoice lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Issue, void, or version an invoice by ID.

payment.heading: Payments
payment.description: Record payments with idempotency keys; replays return the original.

credit.heading: Credits & refunds
credit.description: Create client credits, apply them, or refund payments.

ledger.heading: Ledger
ledger.description: Read-only append-only ledger entries for a case.

balance.heading: Balances
balance.description: Outstanding balances per invoice or case.

tax.heading: Tax rules
tax.description: Versioned tax rules snapshotted onto invoices at issue.

communications.title: Every conversation, linked and auditable.
communications.description: Thread client and case conversations across channels. Outbound messages queue until a provider is wired; nothing is ever sent silently.

placeholders.subject: e.g. Hearing reminder
placeholders.channel: EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP, PHONE, INTERNAL or PORTAL
placeholders.body: Message text (link a case, client, or task)

compose.heading: Compose
compose.description: Write messages; outbound rests at QUEUED until a provider exists.

inbox.heading: Inbox
inbox.description: Read message history by thread, case, client, or channel.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.description: Record explicit delivery transitions and failures.

attachments.heading: Attachments
attachments.description: Attach stored objects to a message.

consent.heading: Consent
consent.description: Manage per-client per-channel opt-in and opt-out.

calendar.title: One agenda, every calendar.
calendar.description: Connect external calendars per tenant, sync without duplicates, resolve conflicts explicitly, and read the unified internal agenda.

connections.heading: Connections
connections.description: Connect accounts and enable or disable sync per tenant.

sync.heading: Sync
sync.description: Push local items to mappings and advance pull cursors.

mappings.heading: Mappings
mappings.description: Local-to-external event links; re-push updates, never duplicates.

conflicts.heading: Conflicts
conflicts.description: Pending conflicts keep both sides until resolved explicitly.

agenda.heading: Agenda
agenda.description: Unified internal view of hearings, deadlines, and tasks by date.

portal.title: Your matters, nothing else.
portal.description: Clients see strictly their own linked records. Nothing here can reach another client's data.

cases.heading: My cases
cases.description: Cases linked to your client record.

documents.heading: My documents
documents.description: Documents linked to your client record.

messages.heading: Messages
messages.description: Messages addressed to your client record.

invoices.heading: Invoices & credits
invoices.description: Your invoices with payments, plus open credits.

transfer.title: Move data in and out, safely.
transfer.description: Validate-then-approve CSV imports with duplicate detection and rollback, plus capped, watermarked exports. Excel arrives with its connector.

import.heading: Import
import.description: Create a job, validate rows, approve with a second person, then run.

jobs.heading: Import jobs
jobs.description: Track status, inspect error rows, roll back completed imports.

export.heading: Export
export.description: Generate capped, watermarked CSV downloads that expire.

notifications.title: Never miss what matters.
notifications.description: Event-driven in-app notifications with per-channel preferences, quiet hours, and escalations. Other channels arrive with their providers.

preferences.heading: Preferences
preferences.description: Per-channel switches and quiet hours. Disabled wins.

rules.heading: Rules
rules.description: Admin event rules, audiences, and escalations.

reports.title: Answers, not raw tables.
reports.description: Define allowlisted reports once, run them on demand or on schedule. Every run respects tenant and assignment scope.

placeholders.name: e.g. Open cases by status
placeholders.dataSource: CASE, CLIENT, PARTY, TASK, INVOICE, PAYMENT, HEARING, DEADLINE or DOCUMENT

run.heading: Run
run.description: Execute a definition with your scope applied.

schedules.heading: Schedules
schedules.description: Daily or weekly scheduled runs with summaries.

dashboard.title: Today at a glance.
dashboard.description: Live operational summary scoped to your tenant and assignments.

kpis.heading: Key figures
kpis.description: Counts across matters, work, and money.

upcoming.heading: Upcoming
upcoming.description: Next hearings, deadlines, and your tasks.

activity.heading: Recent activity
activity.description: Latest case timeline events in scope.

intake.title: From first call to client.
intake.description: Register prospects, triage them, link conflict checks, then approve into clients or reject with a reason.

triage.heading: Triage
triage.description: Review, approve into a client, or reject.

compliance.title: Prove it, hold it, keep it.
compliance.description: Inspect audit trails, govern retention, and place legal holds. No purge automation ships in v1.

placeholders.name: e.g. Matter X litigation
placeholders.reason: Why is this held or released?

audit.heading: Audit trail
audit.description: Search and export capped audit events.
